reason.description: Bounded policy reason retained and audited with each delayed entry.

sourceEntity.description: Entity whose access profile authorizes the read. Omitted for direct reads of the logged entity.

AccessLogSource.description: Governed subject-facing access-log policy for an entity.

exemptions.description: Access profiles whose entries become subject-visible only after a policy delay.

retentionDays.description: Days each entry remains available before bounded background erasure.

subjectField.description: Required plaintext string or text field matched to the subject's verified principal.

trustedIntermediaries.description: Verified intermediary client IDs allowed to forward original requester attribution.

principalClaim.description: The token claim that names the caller. Every profile serves authenticated callers, so every profile names one.

requesterClients.description: The OAuth clients whose tokens may select this profile. Omit to accept every client.

requiredScopes.description: The scopes the verified token must carry: `unrestricted`, or a list of at least one scope, all of which must be present.

rowBoundaries.description: Row reach: `unrestricted`, or a list of at least one row boundary.

AccessRequirementsSource.description: Compile-time requirements, not grants. Profiles must explicitly satisfy them.

allowedPurposes.description: Every profile must restrict purpose to a subset of these values. Omit to demand no purpose.

requiredScopes.description: Every profile must require all these scopes. Requirements never grant access. Omit to demand no scope.

rowBoundaries.description: Every profile must include these exact field, verified-claim, and operator bindings. Omit to demand no row boundary.

ActionHandlerKindSource.description:
The authored action-handler backend. The wasm backend is admitted when
this build of the compiler carries the `wasm` cargo feature, which
validates a declared WASM handler module against the platform guest
ABI at compile time; without that feature a declared WASM handler is
refused with the pinned `breg.action.handler-wasm-build-unsupported`
diagnostic.

ActionHandlerSource.description:
The authored action handler: the shared hook handler declaration, with the
authorization members a governed action adds.

`handler` is [`HookHandlerSource`], the same declaration an entity hook
carries, so this product spells a handler one way. It is flattened, so the
authored member set stays `type`, the source reference the type names,
`abi`, `writes`, and `refusals`. `writes` and `refusals` are this
product's own: they bound what the handler may write and the refusals it
may return, and no hook declares them.

Two rules narrow the shared declaration to what this path runs. `abi` is
optional there and required here, refused at deserialization, because
every backend an action may declare speaks one. The `url` kind is refused
by the compiler at `actions[].handler.type`, because an action handler
runs inside the triggering transaction and cannot be remote.

module.description:
The WASM handler module path, project-local. Declared for wasm
handlers only; the compiler enforces the pairing with the declared
backend.

script.description:
The Rhai handler script path. Declared for rhai handlers only; the
compiler enforces the pairing with the declared backend.

isNull.description: Requires the stored value to be unset. Only `true` is read.

consentIssuer.description: Required when the action creates consent-record rows.

requires.description: Acceptance-time checks over exact existing reference inputs, combined with AND.

rowBoundaries.description: Row reach: `unrestricted`, or a list of at least one row boundary.

selectors.description:
Exact governed selector-profile field map. Every profile field must be
present exactly once and no undeclared field is admitted.

ChangeRequestPlannerKindSource.description:
The authored change-request planner backend. The wasm backend is
expressible so a declared WASM planner is refused by the compiler with a
pinned diagnostic; WASM planners stay unsupported. Retained Rust name for
the reviewed change-request authoring contract.

evidence.description: Governed Evidence acquisitions required immediately before application.

request.description: Predicates over the frozen request intake itself.

targets.description: Existing records read and revision-bound at proposal preparation.

isNull.description: Requires the stored value to be unset. Only `true` is read.

ChangeRequestReviewSource.description:
Either a required review, `type: required` naming `authority` and
`policyId`, or `type: none`.

ConsentDecisionSource.description: Maps the adopter's decision codes onto the engine's decision sets.

refusals.description: Revoke codes never shown to recipients.

revokes.description: Codes that supersede every give on the same key ordered no later.

ConsentIssuerSource.description: Who an action creates consent rows for.

oneOf.description: The subject, bound through a principal link entity.
A reviewed steward act on the subject's behalf.

ConsentRecordSource.description:
The fields of a consent-record entity the engine reads. Other fields are
ignored by consent enforcement.

purpose.description: A vocabulary-code field compared with the verified request purpose.

subject.description: A reference field naming the protected subject row.

ConsentRequirementSource.description: A consent check ANDed into one read permission.

on.description:
The permission entity's field the consent subject references; `id` is
the row's own identity.

ConsentValiditySource.description:
Validity of a consent decision. Every give expires within
`maximumDurationDays`.

from.description: A required timestamp field; a give is active only from this time.

maximumDurationDays.description:
The longest a give lasts, in whole days of 24 hours: at most 3652,
ten years.

until.description:
An optional timestamp field ending the give earlier than
`maximumDurationDays`.

accessProfiles.description: Module profile contributions, read through the sentinels a project profile uses.

accessRequirements.description: Add mandatory requirements only when the entity has none; replacing them is refused.

accessLog.description: Subject-facing record access history, separate from the operational audit.

accessProfiles.description: Module profile contributions, read through the sentinels a project profile uses.

accessRequirements.description: Mandatory request-access requirements checked against every profile, including module contributions.

attachments.description: Governed binary slots on change-request entities, projected under their exact IDs.

consentRecord.description:
Declares this entity's rows as subject-issued consent decisions that
`requireConsent` permissions check before returning a subject's row.

EventConditionSource.description:
Closed Version 1 event selection language.

A tagged shape leaves room for a later, separately governed rule ABI
without turning fields into an ad hoc expression language. The shared
reader's union helper decodes it, so an error inside a variant keeps its
position (CFG-SCHEMA-8). An unset value is named in `beforeIsNull` or
`afterIsNull`; `null` is never a comparison literal (CFG-EMPTY-1).

afterEquals.description: Required values after the change. Valid with created and patched triggers.

afterIsNull.description: Fields that must be unset after the change. Valid with created and patched triggers.

beforeEquals.description: Required values before the change. Valid with patched and tombstoned triggers.

beforeIsNull.description: Fields that must be unset before the change. Valid with patched and tombstoned triggers.

changed.description: Fields whose values must change. Only valid with the patched trigger.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

HookHandlerSource.description:
Where a hook's handler runs.

The pairing rule: `rhai` requires `script`, `wasm` requires `module`,
`url` requires `destinationId`, and each
kind requires exactly its own fields and nothing else. `abi` is required on
`rhai` and `wasm` and forbidden on `url`; its value is closed and checked at
compile time in [`crate::validate_hooks`].

oneOf.description: A reviewed Rhai script in the project.

abi.description: The handler ABI the script speaks.

oneOf.description: A reviewed WASM module in the project.

abi.description: The handler ABI the module speaks.

oneOf.description:
A logical destination bound to a URL and a secret at runtime. The
runtime names the binding it looks the key up in; the project carries
no URL or secret.

destinationId.description: Key in the runtime destination binding.

HookPhase.description: When the hook runs relative to the triggering transaction.

oneOf.description:
Runs inside the triggering transaction and may refuse or shape the
change. Local handler kinds only.

Runs after commit in the post-commit worker and cannot affect the
triggering transaction.

HookSource.description:
One declared hook on an entity.

The shape is [`registry_platform_hooks::HookDeclaration`] with `trigger`
and `when` closed to the vocabulary this compiler validates, and with
`handler` optional. A hook that declares no handler is still recorded in
the outbox and delivered nowhere; production compilation refuses that.

Entity hooks run after the triggering transaction commits, so `phase` is
written and the compiler refuses any value it cannot run.

handler.description:
Governed, destination-neutral delivery. `destinationId` is a key in
runtime `eventDestinations`; the project carries no URL or secret, and
deployment configuration may tighten the bounds it binds but cannot
supply or widen this authority. Production compilation requires it.

id.description: Stable hook contract identifier, sent as `ce-type`. Use a new identifier for a breaking payload change.

phase.description: When the hook runs relative to the triggering transaction.

principal.description:
The access profile a proposal from this hook is applied under.
Optional: a hook that declares none is a non-proposing hook, and a
proposal from one is refused and dead-lettered at delivery time.
Declaring none is not an authoring error.

projection.description: Declared field identifiers to include in `values`. System event metadata is included separately.

trigger.description: Committed record change that can produce this hook.

when.description: Optional field tests, combined with AND. Omit to run on every matching trigger.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

MembershipBoundarySource.description:
A one-hop current membership requirement, combined with every other row boundary.
The root field and membership key must reference the same entity. The active
field is Boolean, and principalField matches the profile's verified principal.

NormalizationStep.description:
A normalization step applied to the canonical string form of an encrypted
value before its blind index is derived. The vocabulary is closed.

oneOf.description: Strips spaces, hyphens, slashes, and dots from the canonical form.

Create records through a durable ingestion run, and nothing else. The
grant is enabled only while an operator-opened import authority is open
for the entity and profile. It declares no item route and no raw batch
route, and change control does not count it as a direct write.

ProvenanceFieldSource.description:
A member of a revision's `changeContext` a profile may read. Each value
is spelled as the member it names is (CFG-NAME-2).

RequestMetadataFieldSource.description: Fields of request decision metadata governed separately from stored record fields.

rowBoundaries.description: Row reach: `unrestricted`, or a list of at least one row boundary.

RequestVisibilitySource.description: Expose only requests created by the current authenticated principal.

RequiredScopes.description:
The scopes a token must carry to select a profile: the keyword
`unrestricted`, or a list of at least one scope.

anyOf.description: Reach the rows every listed boundary binds to the caller's claims.

RowBoundaries.description:
The rows a permission reaches: the keyword `unrestricted`, or a list of at
least one row boundary.

ScalarLiteral.description: A comparison literal: a boolean, a number, or text.

scopeFields.description:
Deprecated bounded predecessor bridge. New authoring should declare
exclusivity only through `constraints[].scopeFields`.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host, no user information, and no whitespace or control character.

actions.description: Named immediate actions introduced by this module.

dependencies.description: Identifiers of modules that must be applied before this module.

extendEntities.description: Additive contributions to entities already declared by the project or another module.

id.description: Stable module identifier, referenced by the project's module lock.

version.description: Module version recorded alongside its content digest in the project.
